title: Approval choices and more reliable startup
summary: Choose how commands are approved, see every effort option, and keep the bar beside your chat. Includes paced DeepSeek sends and Mac/Linux startup fixes.
added: Choose Ask for approval, Approve for me, or Bypass approval in the bar and app Settings.
Native Linux app opens the PlazCode interface in your browser with the memory helper included.
fixed: The PlazCode bar and collapsed tab follow the current chat box after resizing or page changes.
Every desktop effort choice stays reachable.
DeepSeek messages share one queue and wait 8–9.8 seconds from the last send finishing.
Mac can recover a bridge port still held by an older PlazCode process.
notes: Test builds verified and delivered; latest stable remains 1.24.26.
Linux automatic updates are not published yet; use complete native Linux downloads.

sections.title: ✨ What's new
items: Pick Ask for approval, Approve for me, or Bypass approval below Effort or in app Settings. Your choice stays saved across chats and AI sites.
Native Linux download opens the real app interface in your browser.

sections.title: 🛠️ What's fixed
items: Every effort option stays reachable; the bar and collapsed tab follow your chat box.
DeepSeek sends share one queue with 8–9.8 second spacing after a send finishes.
Mac recovers ports held by stale PlazCode processes and leaves other programs alone.

sections.title: 🧪 What was checked
items: Windows, Mac, Linux and browser checks passed. Live AI accounts and the original affected devices remain untested.
Windows is unsigned and Mac is not notarized, as before.
